enriched.title: Present Perfect, Verbos Irregulares e Vocabulário de Tecnologia
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Perfect e outros tempos verbais, com foco em verbos irregulares e terminologias ligadas à tecnologia, como automação e programação. Também há destaque para diferenças de pronúncia e vocabulário específico, além de expressões idiomáticas.
mainTopics: Uso do Present Perfect em diferentes contextos
Conjugação de verbos regulares e irregulares
Vocabulário relacionado à tecnologia e programação
Diferenças de pronúncia e significado de palavras semelhantes

vocabulary.definition: Used to indicate the reason for something.
examples: They canceled the meeting because of this issue.
This is an exciting opportunity for all of us.
I have always wanted to visit Norway.

vocabulary.definition: To risk money or something valuable on an event, hoping to gain something.
examples: They bet a lot of money on the race.
Last year, the biggest tech companies bet big on computers that control themselves.
This region is mainly known for its beautiful beaches.

vocabulary.definition: Being physically or mentally dependent on something.
examples: Programmers are addicted to using AI for coding.

vocabulary.definition: The act of bringing goods or services to someone.
examples: The delivery was delayed due to the weather.

vocabulary.definition: To bring and hand over a product to someone.
To make a process operate by itself.
examples: They plan to automate testing to save time.
The results must be measurable to track progress.
The biggest tech companies will bet big on the future.

vocabulary.definition: The customs, arts, and achievements of a particular group.
examples: Each country has its own unique culture.

grammar.explanation: The Present Perfect is used to describe actions that happened at an unspecified time in the past or actions that began in the past and continue to the present.
rules: Regular verbs have the same form for the past and past participle.
examples: The biggest tech companies have bet big on computers that control themselves.
Economists have long pushed for prediction markets.
commonMistakes: Using the past simple instead of the present perfect to describe actions with relevance to the present.
Forgetting to use 'have' or 'has' in the construction.

grammar.explanation: A aula apresentou a conjugação de verbos no Present Simple, Past Simple, Present Continuous, Past Continuous, Present Perfect e Future.
rules: Present Simple: Usado para fatos ou ações habituais.
Past Simple: Usado para ações concluídas no passado.
Present Continuous: Usado para ações que estão acontecendo agora.
Past Continuous: Usado para ações que estavam acontecendo em um momento específico no passado.
Future Simple: Usado para ações futuras.
examples: Past Simple: Last year, economists pushed for prediction markets.
Future Simple: The biggest tech companies will bet big on computers that control themselves.
commonMistakes: Confundir o uso de tempos contínuos com simples.
Esquecer de usar o auxiliar correto nos tempos compostos.

expressions.usage: Usado para descrever uma dependência ou obsessão por algo.
examples: Programmers are addicted to using AI for coding.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: 'The programmers ___ for prediction markets for years.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence uses Present Perfect to indicate an ongoing action starting in the past and continuing to the present.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct option: 'Last year, they ___ big on AI technology.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence clearly refers to a specific time in the past (last year), so the Past Simple is used.

culturalNotes: Norway is a country known for its fjords and has a rich Viking history.
The Strait of Hormuz is a strategically important waterway for global oil transportation.
studyTips: Practice conjugating irregular verbs daily to improve your fluency.
Focus on understanding the context in which different verb tenses are used.
Listen to native speakers to improve pronunciation of similar-sounding words like 'coast' and 'cost'.
originalExamples: Economists have long pushed for prediction markets. (Economistas há muito tempo têm defendido os mercados de previsão.)
The biggest tech companies have bet big on computers that control themselves. (As maiores empresas de tecnologia apostaram muito em computadores que se controlam.)
The biggest tech companies will bet big on computers that control themselves. (As maiores empresas de tecnologia apostarão muito em computadores que se controlam.)
Programmers are addicted to using AI for coding. (Os programadores são viciados em usar IA para programação.)
Last year, the biggest tech companies bet big on computers that control themselves. (No ano passado, as maiores empresas de tecnologia apostaram muito em computadores que se controlam.)
